author: cellish
body:
Hello there!
I finally finished my new map after like actually no work at all... xD...
Anyways, I just wanted to make something simple and still good, and I've decided to name it "Prima Vera" whic is "Spring" in Spanish and I think that fits pretty good with what the map looks likes so I really hope you guys like it! 
(Looks best on Map Overview xd)

Info

Players: 16v16 or 20v20
Teams: Blue vs Green
Download: http://www.mediafire.com/file/o4avfj3jk6ggs4c/Build_Server.zip
XML: https://github.com/Prodigy4532/Prodigy4532XML/blob/master/Avicus/XML/DTM/Prima%20Vera.xml
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/sbazr
Youtube Video: coming soon
Dont forget to leave a like and subscribe to my channel!
